notes.title: The Maze Survivor: The 9th Entrants — Now Officially Released
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Entrants,[/p][p]We're excited to announce that the full version of [i]The Maze Survivor[/i] —
[b]“The 9th Entrants” — is now officially available![/b][/p][p]This release fixes the overwhelming number of bugs from [i]The First Entrants[/i], improves overall visual quality (yes, the infamous light pollution is gone), and massively expands the game content:[/p][list][*][p]The number of maze zones has increased from [b]8 to 40[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Dozens of new monsters[/b] and [b]hundreds of new items[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Better balance, smoother progression, and [b]far fewer negative feedback loops[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]This time, you'll experience a maze that’s truly rich, mysterious, and satisfying to explore.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]❗Why [i]The First Entrants[/i] Will Be Removed[/h3][p]It is with some regret that we announce:
[b]“The Maze Survivor: First Entrants” will be permanently removed from the store on July 28.[/b][/p][p]As a free prologue, [i]The First Entrants[/i] was our first experimental release. However, due to technical limitations, it suffers from numerous unfixable issues:[/p][list][*][p]Heavy visual pollution and poor lighting design[/p][/*][*][p]Lack of clear clues or direction[/p][/*][*][p]Unbalanced gameplay and too many bugs[/p][/*][/list][p]These flaws have led to many new players getting the wrong impression of the [i]Maze Survivor[/i] series.[/p][p]Unfortunately, I am no longer able to update or maintain [i]The First Entrants[/i]. The most responsible decision is to [b]delist it permanently[/b] and ensure new players experience the game as it was truly meant to be.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🙏 A Note to the First Entrants[/h3][p]If you played the prologue and supported us early on — thank you.
I sincerely hope you’ll give the full version a try.
[i]The 9th Entrants[/i] represents everything we’ve learned, refined, and rebuilt from the ground up. It’s a major leap forward in every way.[/p]

notes.title: "The Maze Survivor: 9th Entrants" Arrive July 14!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45294288/b9c8a28c57286c669e5854d4078c9e5165dc900d.jpg"][/img]Compared to the First Entrants, the [b]Ninth Entrants[/b] bring massive updates across monsters, maze regions, and items.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45294288/971a9df0f7add26e04e8acf6f3f569256fddddde.jpg"][/img]
In this game, you'll experience the [b]ultimate fusion of inspirations[/b] from [b]SCP[/b], [i]The Maze Runner[/i], [i]Lethal Company[/i], [i]The Forest[/i], and [i]The Backrooms[/i].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45294288/76d8cbf48a92cc8fce98379c076a6968980c043e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While building your base in a classic survival sandbox style, your exploration will pit you against deadly threats like [b]mechanical monstrosities[/b], [b]ghosts[/b], and other [b]unpredictable horrors[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45294288/92a779f4dc0b843f03bd7def76b358ead2a30bab.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You’ll also face:[/p][list][*][p][b]Twisting maze puzzles[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Endless traps and shifting mechanisms[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Harsh environmental hazards[/b][/p][/*][*][p]And [b]skeletal soldiers[/b] raiding your stronghold at night...[/p][/*][/list][p]This game offers a [b]truly unique blend[/b] of survival and horror —
[b]a fresh, intense experience unlike anything you’ve played before.[/b][/p]
